title: A lane session opens its PR as a draft: the guard refuses a ready PR from mcp__github__create_pull_request or `gh pr create`
why: Coordinator 13:58 CST Nov 8: #2251 opened ready at 13:42 CST because lane handoff-keeps-owner-waits passed no draft field to mcp__github__create_pull_request. Its CI run then blocked batch 65's merge at 13:56 CST. Fix: refuse create_pull_request, and `gh pr create`, from a cs-build:lane session unless draft is true. The draft-PR guard steps (draft-pr-guard-heredoc, draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm) touch the same guard; check whether it already reads the MCP tool.
note: Coordinator 14:51 CST Nov 8: #2284 (head 4b3efbf42) with runner 8 after rounds 1-3 plus a fix check, lint at head. Cause: the draft guard existed, but the settings.json matcher never listed create_pull_request.
